paper_title: Search for New Physics in Electronic Recoil Data from XENONnT
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper reports 90% C.L. upper limits on solar axions in the (g_ae, g_agamma) plane (Fig. 6a). The solar axion model includes three couplings: g_ae (axion-electron), g_agamma (axion-photon), and g_an^eff (axion-nucleon). The limit on g_agamma is extracted from the 2D projection of the 3D confidence volume. The paper states these limits hold for axion masses up to ~100 eV/c^2, making this a mass-independent bound. The most stringent constraint on g_agamma from this work is approximately 3.5×10^-13 GeV^-1 (read from Fig. 6a). The paper also reports exclusion of the XENON1T 2.3 keV excess at ~4σ significance. No local DM density is assumed as this is a solar axion search, not a galactic halo DM search.
